note: Rustic family campground on the east side of Roche-A-Cri Mound, north of the park office. Four electric sites (one of them the accessible site, with a hard-surface pad), two walk-in tent sites and one tent-only site; the other 33 take trailers or tents. Open late spring to early fall (no dates published). --Claude
